thread:
IncidentBot: PAGER — severity: P1. GPU pool 'gpu-pool-prod-usw2' reporting high contention and failed scaleups. queue_length=+4200, avg_token_latency=492ms, gpu_util=95%. Autoscaler returned errors for last 6m. Paging on-call SRE. https://runbooks.internal/runbooks/gpu-fragmentation

Alex Chen: on it. seeing spike in queued requests to transformer-large variants. tagging ml-infra and oncall.

Priya Rao: I'm oncall. pulling logs now. can someone paste the autoscaler error lines?

Jamal Torres: pasted below from /var/log/autoscaler.log (most recent first):
```
2024-11-09T02:45:12Z ERROR scaler.go:312 scale up failed: NodeGroupScaleUpFailed: quota_exceeded: requested 8 n1-highmem-16 GPUs, available quota 0
2024-11-09T02:43:50Z WARN  placement.go:198 pack failure: MIGFragmentation: attempted assign 4xA100->node but leftover 1 GPU per node, cannot satisfy request
2024-11-09T02:42:10Z ERROR scheduler.go:1450 scheduling stuck: binpack failed, stranded_capacity=6gpus
```

Sarah Nguyen: customer-impact: a few high-traffic customers reported timeouts on hosted API and embeddings jobs are queued. CS is getting tickets.

Hannah Li: confirming — two large customers (acct_8742, acct_2211) showing 500s and request retries. Marking them high priority.

Priya Rao: immediate plan: 1) reduce surface area: pause non-critical low-priority jobs 2) move some traffic to quantized smaller variant (q4) where possible 3) manual relief: create temporary nodes with different MIG sizing to allow binpacking rebuild 4) request emergency quota increase from cloud.

Alex Chen: executing 1 & 2 now. running job tagger to pause jobs: `./tools/jobctl pause --label=priority:low --cluster=gpu-prod`

Alex Chen: paused ~320 low-priority jobs, reduced queue by ~900.

Jamal Torres: starting manual node creation with mixed MIG size: creating 3 nodes of type a2-highgpu-4 (4xA100) to fit smaller requests and reduce fragmentation. command: `gcloud compute instances create ... --accelerator=count=4,type=nvidia-tesla-a100` (internal infra script used).

Priya Rao: autoscaler logs show repeated "MIGFragmentation" errors — core issue seems to be older nodegroups provisioned with 8-GPU partitions while many requests are for 1-2 GPU tasks, leaving 1-2 GPUs stranded per node. binpacking can't co-locate different sized pods due to affinity/anti-affinity constraints.

Kunal Mehta: ML-infra note: some model variants still require contiguous allocation of 2 GPUs due to KV cache placement; we could enable per-request fallback to single-GPU KV mode for some models (through config flag) — that would improve packability. rolling a toggle could help short-term.

Priya Rao: Jamal, can you try enabling single-GPU-KV fallback for transformer-large on the router? config: `model.router.kv_fallback=true` for canary route.

Jamal Torres: applied to canary; monitoring queue.

(5m pass)

Alex Chen: queue decline slowed, token latency down to 380ms. but still above SLO.

Hannah Li: drafted customer status message, sending to impacted accounts now: "We are currently mitigating elevated latency and queueing caused by GPU capacity constraints; we have prioritized your traffic and expect progressive recovery in next 30-45 minutes." :email:

Priya Rao: parallel ops: opening cloud quota request (EMERGENCY) and starting a short-term rebalance by cordoning the old 8-GPU nodegroup and creating new 4-GPU nodegroup that fits smaller pods. will use rolling drain to avoid widespread disruption.

Jamal Torres: command used to cordon a nodegroup: `kubectl label nodes nodegroup-8g cordon=true && kubectl drain ... --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — creating new nodes then allowing scheduler to reschedule smaller pods more tightly.

IncidentBot: NOTE: escalation to Level2 infra required per incident policy after 40min.

Kunal Mehta: FYI enabling the KV fallback reduced per-request GPU need from 2->1 for ~45% of transformer-large traffic in canary. If we flip cluster-wide we estimate reclaiming ~18 GPUs of usable capacity. Recommend flipping to cluster-wide for 20m window then revert.

Priya Rao: doing cluster-wide flip in 2m.

Alex Chen: flip applied. monitoring. queue dropping further.

(10m pass)

Hannah Li: CS updated customers. no new severity escalations.

Jamal Torres: cloud quota team responded: confirmed request received; provisional increase may take 2-6 hours — not helpful for immediate.

Priya Rao: immediate mitigations so far: paused low-prio, KV-fallback flip, manual creation of 3x4GPU nodes. Combined relief ~1400 queued requests down. still seeing ~1.1k queued. Next step: emergency throttling for non-paying/free-tier traffic and promote reserved-dedicated tenants out of shared pool when possible.

Alex Chen: implementing rate-limit: `routerctl set-rate-limit --scope=free-tier --rps=10`

Alex Chen: rate-limit applied, another ~300 queue reduction observed.

Jamal Torres: starting controlled rebalance: cordon nodes in 8g group (one at a time), drain, let scheduler binpack onto 4g and existing 1/2 GPU slots. Monitoring for OOM / eviction.

(Another 12m)

Priya Rao: update: rebalance completed for 60% of 8g nodes. stranded_capacity metric decreased from 6->1 GPUs. queue now ~420. token latency 170ms. customer-facing SLOs recovering.

Hannah Li: pushing update to affected accounts: recovery in progress, will follow up with postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: observed an anomaly: one of the new 4-GPU nodes was mis-labeled causing scheduler to avoid it. fixed label and rescheduled.

Kunal Mehta: follow-ups to prevent recurrence: 1) change default MIG sizing to favor smaller partitions for shared hosted pools 2) add autoscaler check for "MIGFragmentation" and proactively suggest rebalancing 3) document KV-fallback toggle & create automated canary rollout for it 4) telemetry: add per-node stranded_capacity metric.

Priya Rao: handing off to Jamal for post-incident cleanup. Jamal, please coordinate with cloud ops on quota ticket and prepare a postmortem draft. Priya is offcall in 20m.

Jamal Torres: acknowledged. I'll own follow-ups and postmortem. Will schedule a 1hr post-incident review and include action items: quota automation, default nodegroup sizing, scheduled defrag rebalances, and customer communication improvements.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> degraded (active mitigations in place). severity downgraded to P2 at 2045128399.

Sarah Nguyen: thanks team. I'll track customer tickets and coordinate follow-ups with account owners.

Priya Rao: thanks everyone. Good rapid coordination. We'll get a postmortem out in 48h with RCA and timeline. :bow:
__meta_notes: generated thread about GPU capacity exhaustion, autoscaler failures, MIG fragmentation and live mitigations (cordon/drain, KV-fallback, rate-limiting, manual node creation).
